eventDetail.eventTitle: 2027 Southeast Asian Stakeholder Summit on Generative AI for Education (SEA-SSAIE)
eventDetail.about: Computing and Processing; Engineering Profession; General Topics for Engineers
eventDetail.sponsors: KICS-The Korean Institute of Communications and Information Sciences; Philippine Section COM/MTT/AP Chapter; Philippine Section CT Chapter

eventDetail.scope: The conference scope covers artificial intelligence and educational technology, with emphasis on the responsible and human-centered integration of generative AI in teaching, learning, research, and workforce development. It includes AI-enabled education systems, ethical and trustworthy AI, data privacy and governance, educator capacity-building, digital equity, learning innovation, and industry-academe-government collaboration for future-ready education across Southeast Asia.
